ayahs.text: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ
ayahs.translation: CONSIDER the night as it veils [the earth] in darkness,
ayahs.sahih: By the night when it covers

ayahs.translation: and the day as it rises bright!
ayahs.sahih: And [by] the day when it appears

ayahs.translation: Consider the creation of the male and the female!
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa khalaqaz zakara wal unthaa
ayahs.sahih: And [by] He who created the male and female,

ayahs.translation: Verily, [O men,] you aim at most divergent ends!
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, your efforts are diverse.

ayahs.translation: Thus, as for him who gives [to others] and is conscious of God,
ayahs.sahih: As for he who gives and fears Allah

ayahs.translation: and believes in the truth of the ultimate good
ayahs.sahih: And believes in the best [reward],

ayahs.translation: for him shall We make easy the path towards [ultimate] ease.
ayahs.sahih: We will ease him toward ease.

ayahs.translation: But as for him who is niggardly, and thinks that he is self-sufficient,
ayahs.sahih: But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need

ayahs.translation: and calls the ultimate good a lie –
ayahs.sahih: And denies the best [reward],

ayahs.translation: for him shall We make easy the path towards hardship:
ayahs.sahih: We will ease him toward difficulty.

ayahs.text: وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
ayahs.translation: and what will his wealth avail him when he goes down [to his grave]?
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa yughnee 'anhu maaluhooo izaa taraddaa
ayahs.sahih: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls?

ayahs.translation: BEHOLD, it is indeed for Us to grace [you] with guidance;
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, [incumbent] upon Us is guidance.

ayahs.translation: and, behold, Ours is [the dominion over] the life to come as well as [over] this earlier part [of your life]:
ayahs.transliteration: Wa inna lanaa lal Aakhirata wal oolaa
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, to Us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].

ayahs.translation: and so I warn you of the raging fire -
ayahs.sahih: So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing.

ayahs.translation: [the fire] which none shall have to endure but that most hapless wretch
ayahs.sahih: None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one.

ayahs.translation: who gives the lie to the truth and turns away [from it].
ayahs.sahih: Who had denied and turned away.

ayahs.translation: For, distant from it shall remain he who is truly conscious of God:
ayahs.sahih: But the righteous one will avoid it -

ayahs.translation: he that spends his possessions [on others] so that he might grow in purity –
ayahs.sahih: [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself

ayahs.text: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍۢ تُجْزَىٰٓ
ayahs.translation: not as payment for favours received,
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa li ahadin 'indahoo min ni'matin tujzaaa
ayahs.sahih: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded

ayahs.translation: but only out of a longing for the countenance of his Sustainer, the All-Highest:
ayahs.sahih: But only seeking the countenance of his Lord, Most High.

ayahs.translation: and such, indeed, shall in time be well-pleased.
ayahs.sahih: And he is going to be satisfied.
